verdicts.decision_note: The client requests an architectural draft placing three new bathrooms, including one for Unit 3; the administrative timing language is not encoded.
The client specifies the bathroom partition-wall design and requires reuse of existing walls where possible.
The Unit 3 layout discussion establishes moving the bathroom door to avoid obstructing the adjacent kitchen counter.
The client requires toilet positions in the bathroom plans to avoid conflicts with existing drains.
The client specifically requires the Unit 3 toilet drainage design to connect to the existing WC drain.

The freelancer's technical response leaves materially unresolved whether the Unit 3 drain connection belongs in the plan or must be determined during construction; this concerns the narrower drainage sub-behavior identified by audit.
The client explicitly moves the Unit 3 bathroom drain and shower to the left wall; the new locations do not make any prior top-level attribute obsolete.
The freelancer advises that the client's proposed 120 cm width and washer placement would impair bathroom usability, leaving the narrower fixture-fit design unresolved pending the audited split.
